headline: Moderna Shares Plunge on Cancer Vaccine Data Leak
detail: Moderna's stock tumbled after a reported leak of cancer vaccine data. This creates negative sentiment in biotech and could spill over into broader market risk appetite, potentially affecting your tech holdings.
rec: No direct action on your tech/chip holdings, but monitor overall market sentiment for signs of risk-off behavior.

headline: Brent Crude Tops $113 After Trump Hints at Iran Action
detail: Rising oil prices can fuel inflation concerns and potentially lead to higher interest rate expectations. This could put pressure on growth stocks, including your tech and chip names.
rec: No direct action on your tech/chip holdings, but higher energy costs could indirectly weigh on market sentiment for growth stocks.
